summary: Red Bull faces a critical test at Zandvoort as Isack Hadjar's wrist injury forces a driver reshuffle heading into what could be the circuit's final Formula 1 race. The reshuffle reshuffles the team's strategic options and driver lineup stability at a moment when championship points remain fiercely contested. A strong performance here would provide crucial momentum before the season's closing stretch, while a disappointing result could shift the title narrative significantly.
